query:
SELECT 
  sexo, 
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(salario AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 2) as avgSalary,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM users 
WHERE salario IS NOT NULL AND salario > 0
GROUP BY sexo;
